name: Nancy Linehan Charles
bio: Nancy Linehan Charles is an American character actress of film, television and theater. Charles was born in New York City. On screen since the 1990s, she has appeared in more than 70 films and television programs as well as stage productions. Her son is actor Will Rothhaar. Wikipedia
